fullTextZH: 今天胖胖和笨笨去超市了。
fullTextEN: Today Pangpang and Benben went to the supermarket.

fullTextZH: 他们要买很多很多吃的东西。
fullTextEN: They want to buy a lot of food.
May I ask how much a chicken costs?
The clerk said, 'A chicken costs 10 yuan.'
Pangpang said, '10 yuan is too expensive!'
So Pangpang didn't buy the chicken.

fullTextZH: 然后胖胖看到一个西瓜。

fullTextEN: May I ask how much a watermelon costs?

fullTextZH: 店员说：“一个西瓜也10块钱。”
fullTextEN: The clerk said, 'A watermelon also costs 10 yuan.'

fullTextZH: 所以胖胖觉得西瓜不贵。
fullTextEN: So Pangpang thinks the watermelon is not expensive.
"In one week, I want to eat 35 watermelons!"

fullTextZH: 对！胖胖买了很多很多西瓜。
fullTextEN: Yes! Pangpang bought a lot of watermelons.
Because Benben likes to eat chicken.

fullTextZH: “三只鸡、四只鸡、五只鸡、六只鸡、七只鸡！七只！七只！”
fullTextEN: "Three chickens, four chickens, five chickens, six chickens, seven chickens! Seven! Seven!"
Benben eats one chicken every day.

fullTextZH: 明天笨笨还要吃一只鸡！
fullTextEN: Tomorrow, Benben will eat another chicken!
Benben eats a chicken every day!
Pangpang and Benben work out every day.
